summary: Backend-only end-to-end testing of NeuroScout AI. Created pytest suite with 12 tests covering health, validation, full SSE research stream, session list/detail, and delete. All 12 tests PASSED in ~24s. The agent successfully planned sub-questions, searched DuckDuckGo, fetched pages, synthesized a structured report with grounded inline [n] citations mapping to valid references, and persisted the completed session in MongoDB.

minor.issue: Pydantic min_length=3 on query means queries of length 1-2 return 422 as well; this is consistent with, but stricter than, the 'empty query returns 422' requirement. Not a bug, just noting the stricter bound.

Broad `except Exception` silently swallows search errors and returns []; if DDG rate-limits, user only sees 'No sources retrieved'. Consider surfacing the error message in the yielded event for better diagnostics.
On reason-LLM failure, code defaults `sufficient=True` which short-circuits further research - acceptable fallback but worth logging.

Check `if refined and refined not in seen_urls` compares query strings against a set of URLs - this check is effectively always true. Minor logic bug; should dedupe against previously-run queries, not URLs.

action_items: (Optional) Fix the `refined not in seen_urls` bug in agent.py - should track seen_queries separately to avoid re-running the same refined sub-question.
(Optional) Propagate DDG search exception messages into the 'search' SSE event so users can see why zero results came back.
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py line ~257: `if refined and refined not in seen_urls` - comparing a query string to a set of URLs; dedup check is broken. Use a separate `seen_queries` set.
agent.py _ddg_search swallows all exceptions silently - hard to diagnose rate-limit vs network issues; at minimum log the exception.

server.py research_stream: session row is persisted BEFORE the SSE loop starts - good. But if the client disconnects mid-stream, the finally-update block does run (generator is GC'd) but status will stay 'pending' on hard crashes. Consider a cleanup task or timeout to mark stale pending sessions as failed.
agent.py: `_safe_json` handles code fences and loose JSON - solid. Synthesis retry-once fallback is good.
Inline citations are validated against reference IDs (confirmed by test) - agent output is well-grounded.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: None; test creates one ephemeral session per run (query='benefits of green tea') and deletes it at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_neuroscout_api.py covers all backend endpoints. It uses module-level caching to run the expensive SSE stream only once per pytest invocation (~18s of a 24s total run). The test query is 'benefits of green tea' with fallback 'history of the Eiffel Tower' to mitigate DDG rate limits. Expect 12/12 passing. If DDG rate-limits in CI, both queries may fail and 'test_stream_produces_expected_event_sequence' will fail with a diagnostic message - that is infrastructure, not code.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Agent pipeline works end-to-end: plan -> search (1 iter sufficient on simple queries) -> fetch -> synthesize -> final -> done. Report contains 3+ sections, valid references with URLs, inline [n] citations grounded in references. MongoDB persistence verified via GET /api/sessions and GET /api/sessions/{id}. DELETE cascades properly (subsequent GET returns 404).
